Thanks Alex — I read the usage report. High level proposal:

- Option A (preferred): Temporary dedicated headroom carve for XPlane on their existing pool for 48 hours (Nov 8 00:00 UTC — Nov 10 23:59 UTC). We set a hard cap at +200% of their baseline and apply surge rate schedule (TBD by Laura).
- Option B: Autoscale override that reduces the aggressiveness of our eviction/preemption and allows their burst to be served by transient capacity. Lower operational lift but higher risk to global SLOs.

Operational asks:
- Marcus: can we reserve a named slot group for Option A that can be activated/deactivated via the console? If so we prefer that — cleaner rollback.
- Legal/Finance: we need a one-off amendment (short addendum) for billing and liability. Laura, can you draft a short MOU?

I attached a short runbook with triggers and rollback criteria (same Drive link Alex shared). I'll own coordinating the rollback windows and post-event usage reconciliation.

-Kimberly

On Mon, Oct 25, 2026 at 03:18 PM Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai> wrote:
> - Marcus: can we reserve a named slot group for Option A that can be activated/deactivated via the console? If so we prefer that — cleaner rollback.

Short answer: yes, with constraints.

What we can do: carve out a temporary named slice from the EU/US pools (they requested both regions). Activation takes ~30 minutes once pre-provisioned. We'll need a 12-hour lead time to provision the slice and schedule a maintenance window for pre-warm caching. Rollback can be done via the console and will take ~20 minutes to fully drain.

Caveats:
- If other enterprise customers also request the same window we may hit capacity and need to offer a degraded carve (partial %).
- Autoscale override is doable but only at the tier level (not per-slice) unless we accept some engineering sprint work. That would increase risk to SLOs for a short period.

Action items for us:
1) Confirm exact time window and regions (XPlane please confirm UTC offsets).
2) Confirm surge pricing (Laura).
3) Ops will pre-provision the slice on Nov 7 and run a dry-run on Nov 7 18:00 UTC.

I'll add operational knobs to the proposed_override_runbook_v1.pdf and tag the playbook with the on-call rotation.

Marcus Lin
Head of Platform Ops — Redwood Inference
